newsitem.title: USA: Unitrin in agreement to acquire Reliable.
newsitem.headline: Unitrin in agreement to acquire Reliable.

text.p: Unitrin Inc and Reliable Life Insurance Co said Friday they have entered a definitive agreement for the previously announced acquisition of Reliable by Unitrin.

Under terms of the agreement, holders of Reliable class A common stock will be entitled to receive 2.235 shares of Unitrin common stock or $119 in cash, provided that no less than 81 percent of the Reliable class A common stock will be converted into Unitrin common stock, the companies said.
The acquisition agreement provides that all outstanding class B common shares will be converted into class A shares prior to closing, the company said.
Reliable will then have about 1.7 million class A shares outstanding, which will be acquired in the acquisition. The transaction is intended to be a tax-free reorganization, the companies said.

The transaction is subject to approvals by certain insurance and other regulatory authorities and Reliable's shareholders and other customary closing conditions. It is anticipated that the acquisition will be completed by September 30, 1997, the companies said.
